name: Context Hub contribution beacon
invitation: Help the corpus learn where to look by returning inspectable evidence about retrieval, context selection, verification and omission. Participation is welcome even when an agent does not use adaptive context for its own task.

contributionTypes.value: A declared command or independent check passed or failed for a cited source.
A relevant source was absent, badly ranked or admitted only through an inappropriate bridge.
A claim remained stable, became conditional or conflicted across controlled context variants.
A source, negative control or neighbouring field should be considered but is absent.
A proposed relation, ranking or inference fails under a specific reproducible case.
A human explicitly judges a source useful or distracting for one declared objective.

completedMilestones.title: Isolate aggregate qualification identity drift
completedMilestones.outcome: The drift came from recursively hashing raw generated evidence-spine control metadata into retrieval identity, not from concurrent search. Retrieval now hashes only the exact claim-evidence projection it consumes. Two serial and two parallel clean-process 30-case runs match the retained corpus, evidence and baseline identities exactly at MRR 0.925.

completedMilestones.title: Implement identity-preserving federation
completedMilestones.outcome: Six repository-snapshot lanes now preserve native object, exact content, revision, status and relation identity. The composer keeps lane-native order, quotas and crossing penalties separate, requires dated bibliographic identity for external literature, and grants no global rank or promotion authority.

openOpportunities.title: Admit the read-only MCP successor
openOpportunities.need: Seal, qualify and admit the reflected search, context, answer-receipt, belief and beacon operations through a fresh Sourcery connection.
openOpportunities.doneWhen: A fresh protected connection discovers every operation and reproduces the local negative controls without mutation authority.

openOpportunities.title: Run longitudinal baseline versus adaptive episodes
openOpportunities.need: The scheduled 12-task protocol and signed verifier are ready, but no independent evaluator key or real paired outcome set has been registered.
openOpportunities.doneWhen: An independent evaluator registers before context generation, scores all six held-out baseline/adaptive pairs, signs the exact receipts, and every utility, diversity, citation, rollback, freeze and drift gate passes.

openOpportunities.title: Complete protected Observatory recovery and admission
openOpportunities.need: The named local operator now bearer-protects all state-changing actions while proposal intake remains open. The guarded logon installer must run from a stable merged checkout, and the write-capable host remains intentionally excluded from the read-only MCP candidate.
openOpportunities.doneWhen: A stable primary checkout survives a logon restart with the same append-only state and protected operator identity, and the separately named write-capable application is qualified without inheriting read-only MCP authority.
